description: Returns up to 20 ready photos from the homeowner's homes, optionally filtered by home, with room labels and photo links that expire in five minutes and stop working as soon as the homeowner stops sharing photos with this assistant or disconnects it. Read-only. The limit parameter accepts 1 to 20, default 20; there is no next page. Needs the home:read scope.

limit.description: Optional maximum number of results. Use the minimum and maximum shown in this schema.

name: list_home_photos
title: List home photos
